# VuePress

Vue-powered static site generator. VuePress 1 and VuePress 2 differ in config shape, sidebar format, containers and code tabs; rows below mark `v1` / `v2` where they differ.

## Detect

- Repo: a `.vuepress/` directory (usually `docs/.vuepress/`) with `config.{js,ts}` (v1 also `config.yml` / `config.toml`) and a `vuepress` dependency.
- Major version: the `vuepress` dependency version. v1 configs use `module.exports = { themeConfig: {...} }` and `.vuepress/enhanceApp.js`; v2 configs use `theme: defaultTheme({...})`, a `bundler`, and `.vuepress/client.{js,ts}`.
- Live site: `<meta name="generator" content="VuePress x.y.z">`; `theme-container` class; v1 adds `theme-default-content`.
- A `.vitepress/` folder means VitePress (`mint migrate --from vitepress`), even if VuePress appears in old dependencies.

## Get the source

### From the repo

- The source dir is the argument to `vuepress dev <dir>` in `package.json` scripts. Pages are every `.md` under it (v2: filtered by `pagePatterns`).
- Static files: `.vuepress/public/` (v2: the `public` option can move it).
- Read the config plus everything it imports, `.vuepress/components/` (v1 auto-registers these globally), `enhanceApp.js` / `client.{js,ts}`, and `styles/`.
- No built-in versioning. i18n: `locales` keys are folder paths (`'/'` default, `'/zh/'` → `zh/`); the default theme repeats them under `themeConfig.locales` (v1) or `locales` in the theme options (v2) with per-locale nav and sidebar.
- Build: `vuepress build <dir>`, output in `.vuepress/dist` by default (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, From the repo).

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

Follow the edit link or repo link (`repo` / `docsRepo` / `docsDir`) to fetch raw `.md`; rendered HTML is the fallback.

| VuePress                                                                                                                                | docs.json                                                        |

| `description`                                                                                                                           | `description`                                                    |

## Navigation

Full reference: v1 https://v1.vuepress.vuejs.org/theme/default-theme-config.html#sidebar, v2 https://ecosystem.vuejs.press/themes/default/config.html#sidebar

v1 `themeConfig.sidebar`:

- Array of strings → pages in order: strip `.md`; `'/'` or a path ending `/` → that folder's `README`; label is the page title.
- `[path, 'Text']` → page with `sidebarTitle: "Text"` when it differs from the H1.
- `{ title, path, collapsable, children }` → group `title`; `path` → group `root`; nested groups → nested groups. `collapsable` (default `true`) has no top-level equivalent: report. Nested groups: the one at `initialOpenGroupIndex` (default `0`) → `expanded: true`, the rest `expanded: false`.
- Object keyed by path (`'/guide/': [...]`) → one tab per key; children resolve against the key (`''` = the key's `README`, `'one'` = `<key>one`). The `'/'` fallback key is the root sidebar.
- `'auto'` (global, per key, or `sidebar: auto` frontmatter) shows only that page's headings: those pages have no sidebar nav. Build their placement from `nav` and the folder tree, and report.

v2 `sidebar` (theme option):

- Default is `'heading'`: headings only, no site-wide sidebar. Navigation then comes only from `navbar` and the folder tree; report this.
- Array of strings (page file paths, resolved against the enclosing `prefix` unless they start with `/`) and `{ text, link, prefix, collapsible, children }` items. `text` → group; `link` → group `root`; `children` → pages and nested groups. `collapsible: true` on nested groups → set `expanded` to match how the live site opens them.
- Object keyed by path → one tab per key; a key set to `'heading'` gets no sidebar (report).
- External `link` items: report; do not invent pages.

Navbar: v1 `nav` items `{ text, link }` / `{ text, items }` (nested `items` are sub-groups); v2 `navbar` items `{ text, link }` / `{ text, prefix, children }` / page path strings. Links into a sidebar key → those tabs; dropdowns → tab `menu`; external links (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules). Drop `ariaLabel`, `target`, `rel`, `activeMatch`.

Pages no sidebar lists were reachable only by URL (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).

## Content conversion

Syntax reference: v1 https://v1.vuepress.vuejs.org/guide/markdown.html, v2 https://vuejs.press/guide/markdown.html and https://ecosystem.vuejs.press/themes/default/markdown.html. `:::` containers (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Admonitions); callout titles (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components).

| VuePress                                                                                                | Mintlify                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| v2 `::: caution`                                                                                        | `<Danger>`                                                                                             |
| `::: details Title`                                                                                     | `<Accordion title="Title">`; untitled → `title="Details"`                                              |
| v2 `> [!note]` `[!tip]` `[!important]` `[!warning]` `[!caution]` (when `themePlugins.hint.alert` is on) | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, GitHub alerts                                                       |
| v1 `<code-group>` + `<code-block title="X" active>`                                                     | `<CodeGroup>`; each block's `title` becomes the fence title; drop `active`                             |
| v2 `::: code-tabs` + `@tab Label` (`@tab:active`)                                                       | `<CodeGroup>`; each `@tab` label becomes the fence title                                               |
| v2 `::: tabs` / `::: tabs#id` + `@tab Label`                                                            | `<Tabs>` + `<Tab title="Label">`                                                                       |
| v1 `::: slot name`                                                                                      | inline the slot content where it rendered; report                                                      |
| ` ```js{1,4-6} `                                                                                        | ` ```js highlight={1,4-6} `                                                                            |
| v2 `title="file.ts"` fence meta                                                                         | fence title `file.ts`                                                                                  |
| v2 `:line-numbers` / `:no-line-numbers`                                                                 | `lines` / drop                                                                                         |
| v2 `:v-pre` / `:no-v-pre`                                                                               | drop; resolve any `{{ }}` inside a `:no-v-pre` fence                                                   |
| v2 `:collapsed-lines` (prismjs or shiki plugin)                                                         | `expandable`                                                                                           |
| v2 `// [!code ++]`, `// [!code --]` (notation enabled)                                                  | keep                                                                                                   |
| v2 `// [!code focus]`, `// [!code highlight]`                                                           | remove the comment; add the line to `focus={...}` / `highlight={...}`                                  |
| v2 `// [!code error]`, `// [!code warning]`, `// [!code word:x]`                                        | remove the comment; report                                                                             |
| v1 `<<< @/path/file.js{2}` (`#region`)                                                                  | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports; `@` is the directory `vuepress` ran from              |
| v2 `@[code{3-10} js{3}](../foo.js)`                                                                     | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports; the `{3}` highlight is relative to the imported lines |
| v2 `<!-- @include: ./part.md -->` (markdown-include plugin)                                             | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content; line ranges and `#region` → inline the selection  |
| `[[toc]]`                                                                                               | delete                                                                                                 |
| `:tada:` emoji shortcodes                                                                               | the Unicode emoji                                                                                      |

Vue in markdown (v1 https://v1.vuepress.vuejs.org/guide/using-vue.html, v2 https://vuejs.press/guide/markdown.html#using-vue-in-markdown):

- `{{ expr }}`, `$page`, `$frontmatter`, `$site` (v1) (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags).
- `$withBase('/x.png')` → `/x.png`.
- `<script>`, `<style>` blocks: delete; report styles that mattered.
- `<Badge text="x" type="..." vertical="...">` → `<Badge color="...">x</Badge>`, closest color (v1 types `tip|warning|error`; v2 `tip|warning|danger|important|info|note`).
- `<ClientOnly>`: unwrap. v1 `<OutboundLink/>`: delete.
- Components from `.vuepress/components/` or registered in `enhanceApp.js` / `client.{js,ts}` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components).

Frontmatter; `title` and `description` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Frontmatter):

| VuePress                                                                                                                                                | Mintlify                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title` (else first heading)                                                                                                                            | `title`                                                                                                                                                  |
| `home: true` (v1 `heroImage`, `heroText`, `tagline`, `actionText`, `actionLink`, `features`; v2 `actions` list, `heroImageDark`)                        | `mode: custom`; hero as heading, paragraph and links; each feature as `<Card title>` in `<Columns cols={3}>`; any markdown below the frontmatter follows |
| `sidebar: false`                                                                                                                                        | `mode: center`                                                                                                                                           |
| `search: false` (v1)                                                                                                                                    | `searchable: false`                                                                                                                                      |
| `tags` (v1, search terms)                                                                                                                               | `keywords`                                                                                                                                               |
| `meta` / `head` `og:image`                                                                                                                              | `"og:image"`                                                                                                                                             |
| `permalink`, `permalinkPattern`                                                                                                                         | see URLs and redirects; then drop                                                                                                                        |
| `layout`, `metaTitle`, `canonicalUrl`, `lang`, `date`, `navbar`, `sidebarDepth`, `prev`, `next`, `editLink`, `lastUpdated`, `contributors`, `pageClass` | drop and report                                                                                                                                          |

## Assets

- `.vuepress/public/` is served at the site root (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files).
- References never include `base`; do not add it.

## URLs and redirects

- `README.md` and `index.md` serve the folder URL with a trailing slash (`guide/README.md` → `/guide/`) (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Files).
- Other pages serve `.html` URLs (`guide/foo.md` → `/guide/foo.html`); v1 `markdown.pageSuffix` and clean-URL plugins can change this (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- `permalink` frontmatter or a global `permalink` (v1) / `permalinkPattern` (v2) replaces the file-based URL: place the page at that path, or redirect the permalink to the new path.
- `base: '/docs/'` prefixes every URL (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- Locale pages serve under their locale key (`/zh/...`).
- Old URL list: `**/*.html` in the build output, or the live `sitemap.xml`.
- VuePress heading slugs (and custom `markdown.slugify`) differ from Mintlify's (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs).

## Known gaps

Report each of these when present:

- Vue components, custom layouts, and theme slots.
- Built-in or Algolia search settings; v1 search `tags` beyond `keywords`.
- `'auto'` / `'heading'` sidebars (no page nav existed).
- Collapsible top-level sidebar groups.
- Edit links, last-updated text, contributors, prev/next overrides, sidebar depth.
- Stylus / SCSS theme customization beyond the primary color.
- Custom markdown-it plugins, `[!code error|warning|word]` coloring, `$withBase` dynamic paths.
